auth_details: Demo: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3 with x-cg-demo-api-key (or query x_cg_demo_api_key). Paid Pro: https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3 with x-cg-pro-api-key (or x_cg_pro_api_key); Pro keys must not target the Demo host.
free_tier_limits: Demo API: 10,000 call credits/month and 100 requests/minute; attribution required.
rate_limits: Demo: 100 calls/min (and 10,000 call credits/month). Paid tiers vary by plan (e.g. Basic 300/min, Analyst/Lite 500/min); check the current pricing matrix.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right — Demo host+header vs Pro host+header are separate; docs and error 10010/10011 enforce it (https://docs.coingecko.com/demo/reference/authentication, https://docs.coingecko.com/reference/authentication, https://docs.coingecko.com/docs/errors-and-rate-limits). free_tier_limits + rate_limits: auditor right — Demo is 100 calls/min and 10k monthly credits, not 30/min (https://docs.coingecko.com/docs/errors-and-rate-limits, https://www.coingecko.com/en/api/pricing); attribution required on Demo column of pricing page.
